entries.a290fa003da4e686: This is a reportable segment in Japan, centered on the insurance agency business that sells non-life insurance and life insurance to individual and corporate customers. Domestic subsidiaries select, from the many products created by insurers, those that suit customers' needs from a third-party standpoint, and sell them on behalf of the insurers. As of December 31, 2025, Agent Insurance Group Co., Ltd. had agency contracts with a total of 40 insurers, Financial Japan Co., Ltd. with a total of 47 insurers, and Hoken Shop Agent Co., Ltd. with a total of 13 insurers. The growth pillars are business succession and M&A that take in small and medium-sized insurance agencies that find it difficult to continue, for example because they have no successor, and support for insurance sales representatives who join under the 'Insurance Agency Support Platform' that supports both sales and administrative operations. Cosmo Ability Co., Ltd. is a systems development company whose shares were acquired in January 2025 for the purpose of using technology within the group. Operating revenue of the domestic business for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥12,735,604 thousand, and segment profit was ¥131,337 thousand. No comparison with the previous period is given, as the company was established on July 1, 2025.

entries.a8b114e2844e5003: A reportable segment carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Agent America, Inc., which operates an insurance agency and insurance brokerage business in the United States. It has 4 offices, 2 in California, 1 in Texas, and 1 in Atlanta, and serves mainly Japanese companies and U.S.-based expatriates. Insurance business in the United States requires a license under each state's laws, and the company's strength is that it can sell insurance in 40 of the 50 states (and 1 other special district). For the fiscal year ended December 2025, the Overseas Business had operating revenue of ¥330,770 thousand and segment profit of ¥10,435 thousand. The securities report states that it strengthened its partnerships with major brokers and that new customer acquisition was notable, especially in the health insurance division.
